scripts.retry: npm run audit && npm run build && npm run test && npm run cover && npm run lint | grep -E error\|Shadlib/src
scripts.audit: echo ">> auditjs" && auditjs ossi --quiet -w auditjs-whitelist.json -u "$(<secrets/auditjs.ossi.username)" -p "$(<secrets/auditjs.ossi.password)" && echo ">> npm audit" && npm audit && echo ">> audit complete"
scripts.test: : Run tests and generate coverage reports                                    ; echo "Running Tests"               && ./timeout.sh 300 nyc        --reporter html --reporter json mocha --cache --all --include-all-sources --reporter mocha-multi --reporter-options mocha-multi=mocha-multi.json build/test -x build/test && echo "Tests Complete"
scripts.cover: : Run tests and generate coverage reports                                    ; echo "Generating Coverage Reports" && ./timeout.sh 300 nyc report --reporter html --reporter json                                                                                                                                           && echo "Reports Complete"
scripts.open: open reports/mochawesome/mochawesome.html && open coverage/index.html && open doc/index.html
scripts.test:one: : Run tests with debug output up to the first error                          ; echo "Running Tests" && DEBUG=Abortable,Awaitable,Asyncable,AsyncablePromise,DeferredAsyncablePromise ./timeout.sh 300 mocha --reporter mocha-multi --reporter-options mocha-multi=mocha-multi:one.json --recursive build/test/**/*.spec.js --bail && echo "Tests Complete"
